item.title: Coast Guard suspends search for missing kayaker, 21, in Hood Canal
item.description: The Coast Guard suspended its search Saturday for a 21-year-old kayaker who went missing in the Hood Canal near Hazel Point after his kayak overturned Friday night.

item.title: Flaw revealed in Wash. troopers’ DUI crackdown
item.description: OLYMPIA — Ahead of the Super Bowl last week, the Washington State Patrol announced that the agency would increase its patrols in search of intoxicated drivers.

item.title: After Supreme Court’s tariff takedown, Washington firms wary of what comes next
item.description: Washington business owners were feeling cautiously optimistic after the U.S. Supreme Court on Friday morning struck down a broad swath of tariffs imposed by the Trump administration.

item.title: EU says U.S. must honor trade deal after court blocks Trump’s tariffs
item.description: BRUSSELS — The European Union's executive arm requested “full clarity” from the United States and asked its trade partner to fulfill its commitments after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down some of President Donald Trump’s most sweeping tariffs.

item.title: ‘One Battle After Another’ wins 6 prizes, including best picture, at Britain’s BAFTA film awards
item.description: LONDON — Politically charged thriller “One Battle After Another” took six prizes, including best picture, at the British Academy Film Awards on Sunday, building momentum ahead of the Oscars next month. Blues-steeped vampire epic “Sinners” and gothic horror story “Frankenstein” won three awards each, while Shakespearean family tragedy “Hamnet” was named best British film.

item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel
item.description: MEXICO CITY — The Mexican army killed the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, Nemesio Rubén Oseguera Cervantes, “El Mencho,” on Sunday, decapitating what had become Mexico's most powerful cartel and giving the government its biggest prize yet to show the Trump administration its efforts.

item.title: U.S. military strikes another alleged drug boat in eastern Pacific, killing three
item.description: WASHINGTON — The U.S. military said Friday that it has carried out another deadly strike on a vessel accused of trafficking drugs in the eastern Pacific Ocean. U.S. Southern Command said on social media that the boat “was transiting along known narco-trafficking routes in the Eastern Pacific and was engaged in narco-trafficking operations.”

item.title: Murray, other Northwest Democrats to skip Trump’s State of the Union
item.description: WASHINGTON — When President Donald Trump speaks to House and Senate lawmakers Tuesday for his first official State of the Union address since returning to office, some Northwest Democrats plan to skip the spectacle and counter it with their own messaging efforts.

item.title: Union girls among four local teams to open state tournament in Camas
item.description: Fort Vancouver, Camas and Columbia River boys and Union girls learned Sunday they will open the state tournament close to home at Camas.

item.title: Clingan scores 23 points to lead Trail Blazers past short-handed Suns 92-77
item.description: PHOENIX (AP) — Donovan Clingan had 23 points, 13 rebounds and four blocked shots to lead the Portland Trail Blazers past the short-handed Phoenix Suns, 92-77 on Sunday night.
